import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Build a tree structure grouped by directory
tree = {}
for e in entries:
    # Get relative path by stripping /workspace/
    rel = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = rel.split("/")
    # Group by top-level directory
    top = parts[0]
    if top not in tree:
        tree[top] = []
    tree[top].append({"rel": rel, "size": e.get("size_bytes", 0), "is_dir": e.get("is_dir", False)})

# Print organized tree
output_lines = []
output_lines.append(f"📂 Workspace Files ({len(entries)} total)\n")

for top_dir in sorted(tree.keys()):
    items = tree[top_dir]
    output_lines.append(f"📁 {top_dir}/")
    for item in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x["rel"]):
        rel = item["rel"]
        size_kb = item["size"] / 1024
        indent = "  " * (rel.count("/"))
        name = rel.split("/")[-1]
        if size_kb >= 1:
            output_lines.append(f"{indent}📄 {name}  ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")
        else:
            output_lines.append(f"{indent}📄 {name}  ({item['size']} B)")
    output_lines.append("")

formatted_tree = "\n".join(output_lines)
print(formatted_tree)
